g.text: CL-Bench | Complete systems | GLM-5.3-Flash high | R=1
353 scored tasks + 1 user-interrupted unscored task. Hatched Hermes Codebase bars cover 18 tasks, not 19.
* Missing request usage: reported token sums are incomplete. Selected scored tasks only; full campaign costs are separate.
Mixed output budgets and Codex consolidation schedules; different complete systems. No causal memory or stable-ranking claim.
